headline: Wetland permit requests for a car wash on Pawtucket Boulevard, a parking lot on Stedman Street, and other projects.
summary: Enforcement orders cover tree cutting near wetlands at 4 Epirus Drive and 300 Pawtucket Blvd. Other items include a home at 10 Old Ferry Road, an addition at 35 Tanner Street, and a garage with an accessory dwelling unit at 450 Pawtucket Street.

The City of Lowell • Dept. of Planning and Development • Division of Development Services

P: 978.674.4144 • F: 978.446.7103

Yovani Baez-Rose 
Assistant City Manager/DPD Director 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
November 13, 2026 
 
 
In accordance with the Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 131, Section 40, and the City of Lowell 
Wetland Ordinance Section 280.1 -13, the Lowell Conservation Commission  will hold a meeting on 
Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 6:30 PM in-person in the Mayor’s Reception Room, 375 Merrimack 
Street, Lowell MA 01852.  
 
Meeting will be held in the Mayor’s Reception Room, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852 
with public welcome and by using remote participation as follows: Members of the public may 
view the meeting via ltc.org or local cable channel 6. Those wishing to speak regarding a specific 
agenda item shall register to speak in advance of the meeting by sending an email to 
dricker@lowellma.gov mbrundage@lowellma.gov AND pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov indicating 
the agenda item and a phone number to call so that you may be issued zoom link to the 
meeting. If no access to email, you may contact Development Services at 978 -674-4144. All 
requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
 
Review the project materials online at: https://lowellma.gov/1100/Conservation-Commission

Request for Determination of Applicability  
Vicki O’Neil 
31 Anderson Way 
Tyngsborough, MA 01879 
Project Location: 10 Old Ferry Road, 01854 
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by Vicki O'Neil to construct a single-family 
home at 10 Old Ferry Rd. The applicant is seeking to determine whether the proposed work is located 
within the 100-foot buffer zone of a protected wetland. 
 
Request for Determination of Applicability  
CSX Transportation  
500 Water Street  
Jacksonville, FL 32202
Project Location: Lowell Train Tack Right-Of-Way  
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by CSX Transportation, Inc, regarding their 
plans for weed control via herbicide. The applicant is seeking to determine where the proposed work is 
located within the 100-foot buffer zone of a wetland resource area.  
 
Notice of Intent 
Sokhay Danh 
Lowell Sewing, Inc 
35 Tanner Street 
Lowell, MA 01852 
DEP #: 206-0855 
Project Location: 35 Tanner Street, 01852 
A Notice of Intent has been filed by Lowell Sewing, Inc to construct an addition to the existing industrial 
building and associated grading at 35 Tanner Street. The proposed work is within the 100-foot buffer 
zone to a protected wetland. 
 
  
Enforcement Order  
Alish and Jigarkumar Bhagat  
4 Epirus Drive  
Lowell, MA 01854  
Violation Location: 4 Epirus Drive, 01854  
An Enforcement Order has been issued against 4 Epirus Drive. The violator has cut trees within the 100-
feet of a Bordering Vegetated Buffer (BVW).  
 
Enforcement Order  
Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation (North Regional Office)  
25 Shattuck Street  
Lowell, MA 01852  
Violation Location: 300 Pawtucket Blvd. (Rynne Beach)  
An Enforcement Order has been issued against 300 Pawtucket Blvd. The violator has dug test pits and 
cut trees within the 100-feet of Clay Pit Brook and the Merrimack River. The work was also performed 
within the FEMA 100-year flood plain.
